name: SuddenJump
epl: @Name('SuddenJump') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(origin='reconstructed') -> b=Event(origin='reconstructed' and (b.value - a.value > 5 or a.value - b.value > 5))]

name: ConsistentIncrease
epl: @Name('ConsistentIncrease') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent, c as thirdEvent from pattern [every a=Event(origin='reconstructed') -> b=Event(origin='reconstructed' and b.value > a.value) -> c=Event(origin='reconstructed' and c.value > b.value)]

name: SpikeThenDrop
epl: @Name('SpikeThenDrop') select a as rise, b as peak, c as drop from pattern [every a=Event(origin='reconstructed') -> b=Event(origin='reconstructed' and b.value > a.value) -> c=Event(origin='reconstructed' and c.value < b.value)]

name: Flatline
epl: @Name('Flatline') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(origin='reconstructed') -> b=Event(origin='reconstructed' and b.value = a.value)]
